user.title: Connect a BLANCO device
user.description: Turn on device data sharing for your device in the BLANCO UNIT app first. Then enter the serial number and service code shown in the app under Settings > Device information.

data_description.serial_number: The serial number from Settings > Device information in the BLANCO UNIT app.
data_description.service_code: The five digit service code from the same page.

reauth_confirm.title: Allow access again
reauth_confirm.description: The BLANCO Cloud no longer accepts this installation. Turn on device data sharing in the BLANCO UNIT app again, then submit.

error.not_granted: The BLANCO Cloud does not allow access to this device. Check the serial number and service code and turn on device data sharing in the BLANCO UNIT app.
error.unsupported_device: This BLANCO device does not support the Smart Home API.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BLANCO Cloud.

access_revoked.message: The BLANCO Cloud no longer allows access to the device.

update_failed.message: Could not fetch the data from the BLANCO Cloud: {error}
